description_en: This operation generates SQL statements based on the current query information and associated data tables. This API is suitable for scenarios where your database is stored locally and cannot be accessed by Xiyan. You can associate a virtual data source with Xiyan, call this API to generate the SQL statements, and then parse and execute them locally. For more information, see the best practices document
description_zh:
运行sql生成，根据当前的query信息，结合已关联的数据表，进行sql语句的生成。

该接口适合以下场景：
您的数据库在本地，不能被析言访问。
您可以通过析言关联虚拟数据源，调用该接口生成SQL，然后自行解析和执行SQL。

具体的使用，可以参考以下最佳实践文档：
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/xiyan-gbi-local-data-best-practices
kebab_example: aliyun dataanalysisgbi run-sql-generation --workspace-id llm-2v3934xtp49esw64 --specification-type STANDARD_MIX --query '请问销量前十的产品有哪些' --session-id d5eced84-fd25-43ee-a245-adb4e4a8c3be --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunSqlGeneration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace used for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The version information specified for the current request. If empty, the default workspace version is used
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求指定使用的版本信息，不填时使用默认业务空间版本
parameters.name: specification_type

parameters.example: 请问销量前十的产品有哪些
parameters.help_en: The query entered by the user
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The message session ID. Multiple request IDs can belong to the same session ID
parameters.help_zh: 消息会话ID，多条requestId可以属于同一个会话sessionId
parameters.name: session_id
